newsitem.title: USA: US ag attache - Argentina 96/97 wheat crop 15.8 MMT.
newsitem.headline: US ag attache - Argentina 96/97 wheat crop 15.8 MMT.

text.p: A U.S. agricultural attache raised his estimate for Argentina 1996/97 wheat production to 15.8 million tonnes from 15.5 million tonnes, in line with Argentine government forecasts.

In a report dated April 29 that was released in here Wednesday, the attache also lifted his forecast for marketing year exports to 11.3 million tonnes. However, exports for the July/June year were not increased, reflecting the slower, steady sales and shipment pace in the short term to the key Brazilian market, the attache said.

Attache reports are not official USDA data. In its last monthly World Supply and Demand report on April 11, USDA forecast Argentina 1996/97 wheat production at 15.5 million tonnes and pegged exports at 11.0 million tonnes. USDA is slated to release the May Supply and Demand report on Monday.
In the report, the attache left his estimate for Argentina 1996/97 corn output unchanged at 14.5 million tonnes, matching the department's forecast.
